column1: Vertical map: 180 m from the rim floor to the vault; the plan view is stacked, so the cross-section in the image is the real layout. Every zone below the rim has at least one overlook onto the abyss on its west side.

The Rim: 800 m across; the hatch at the centre; bone stakes at r=350 m mark the worm's line. Beyond the stakes the sand shakes for 8 s, then the worm consumes the diver (no down). The worm is visible tunneling at r=450-600 at all times: a horizon feature, nothing more.

Training loop (station): Mess -> caiman corridor -> Labs -> pressure door -> Reactor -> service shaft (one-way back up to the Mess). About 2 min, indoors, past the seal, the caiman, and the vent trap.

Training loop (deep): Galleries -> Warrens -> Airlock A -> Mess -> Reactor -> Vault -> vault stair back -> Reactor -> Labs -> Airlock B -> Warrens -> Galleries. About 6 min; the only loop that touches both Lockers.

Blood flow: almost none. The water barely moves, so blood pools where it's made (decay 0.5% base here, not 2%); the only currents are the reactor's warm plume (rises from the Reactor up the service shaft into the Mess) and the brine pool's drain over Overlook 3.

Sightlines: rim unlimited but dark (lamp 25 m); galleries 20 m; warrens 8 m; station 10-15 m; vault 40 m. Alarm regions: Rim, Galleries and Warrens, Station, Vault; the Remnant enters at the two airlocks and the upper airlock.

Specimens: salamanders breed +1 per 90 s per pair in the bunks and coelacanths +1 per 120 s per pair in the wet lab (cap 12 each); only the caiman eats them. An overrun station is loud and full of blood whenever a Remnant squad passes through.
